profile.headline: UI Engineer | Gameplay Engineer | Computer Science | Unreal and Unity Engines | Programmer
profile.jobTitle: Gameplay Software Engineer on Assignment at Meta
profile.summary:
My passions for programming, storytelling, and social justice have lead me to the video game industry with a desire to stretch this form of media to its limits creatively and technically. I believe experimenting with the unexpected is a great way to continue to learn and find joy in what you do, as a commitment to learning means every day will find a way to surprise you.

Having worked on projects of all sizes, from solo prototypes all the way to to AAA games with international teams, I've had a hand in working on many frontend systems like UI/UX, Gameplay, and AI with some experience in connecting such systems to the backend side of things. My primary experience is in the Unreal and Unity Engines, but I'm not afraid to dive in and try something new.

positions.title: Gameplay Software Engineer on Assignment at Meta
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Developed a procedural level generation system with designer-facing controls for layout, enemy composition, and visual theming for internal gameplay prototypes.
- Built reusable gameplay templates, including endless runner and fighting game frameworks, to accelerate onboarding and prototyping.
- Partnered with product and editor teams to identify usability issues, document bugs, and improve internal tooling, contributing to an 84% issue resolution rate.
- Authored onboarding documentation and sample projects to support internal feature testing and external developer adoption.
positions.insights: Skills: Gameplay Programming · JavaScript · Video Game Production

positions.title: Associate Gameplay Engineer
positions.description:
- Short stay at Ubisoft due to role being made redundant
- Implemented new nodes in the Snowdrop visual scripting framework to improve tracking and synchronization of player map and game mode data.
- Developed a data-driven UI icon workflow that simplified designer customization and reduced implementation complexity. 
- Debugged and refactored the multiplayer voting system to guarantee unique map ballot generation and consistent randomization behavior.

positions.title: Game Programmer
positions.description:
- Architected and implemented diegetic and non-diegetic UI systems in Unreal Engine using Common UI and custom gameplay functionality.
- Developed a modular AI behavior system for player detection and response, enabling rapid creation of new enemy archetypes by designers and increasing implementation speed by 30%.
- Prototyped and implemented core player systems including stealth, interaction, dialogue, animation state logic, and gameplay behaviors in collaboration with design and production teams.
- Created an in-editor AI route-building tool that streamlined path creation workflows through a simplified designer-facing interface.
positions.insights: Skills: Unreal Engine 4 · Programming · Game Development · Unreal Engine 5 · Perforce

positions.title: UI/UX Engineering and Technical Design Intern
positions.description:
-Owned the Fortnite cosmetic locker system, initially focusing on debugging to aid in large-scale refactoring of older systems.
-Collaborated with designers to implement a new tagging system for cosmetics and to improve searchability of items by qualities and groupings by reducing the number of tags by 15%.
-Utilized this new tagging system to create new sorts and filters for cosmetics to address complaints of inconsistent item ordering, resulting in greater player satisfaction.
-Refactored a 3D spatial navigation scene for the Christmas holiday event, specifically the selection/opening of gifts and customizing the gifting screen background.
positions.insights: Skills: Unreal Engine 4 · Programming · C++ · Game Development · Unreal Engine 5 · Perforce · Visual Studio

positions.title: Engineering Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Helped instruct Intermediate Game Design, Fundamentals of Procedural Media, and Procedural Expression courses (On average 24 students per class)
- Assisted students with questions regarding Unity, Processing, Perforce, and their game projects with an emphasis on engineering/programming challenges
- Helped update and create curriculum for a digital format, designing assignments and working the professor to execute changes
positions.insights: Skills: Design Documents · Programming · Game Development · Unity · C# · Perforce · Visual Studio

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
- Co-created and engineered a Nintendo Switch-focused multiplayer title, researching motion-control interaction design and documenting platform-specific development workflows.
- Led and mentored engineers across gameplay implementation, documentation, onboarding, and task delegation.
- Developed the game’s gameplay UI, player customization, and combat systems from prototype through Steam release on PC in 2021.
- Represented engineering in cross-discipline reviews and external meetings, communicating technical feedback, risks, and implementation priorities.
positions.insights: Skills: Design Documents · Programming · Game Development · Unity · C# · Perforce · Nintendo Switch · Visual Studio

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with artists and designers to debug UI issues and streamline asset integration
- Converted the game’s multiple button formats to a single one to allow for faster game wide iteration and simplify future implementation
- Created support for season-related inbox messages, building out the menu prefabs and their functionality for future implementation
- Implemented new functionality for the game’s buy throughs, working client and server-side to ensure conditions matched on both ends
positions.insights: Skills: Design Documents · Programming · C++ · Game Development · Unity · Mobile Games · C#

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Part of the inaugural class of SMASH Rising, a career readiness program for SMASH alumni entering their first or second year of college
- Alumni teams participating in SMASH Rising use design and prototype thinking to solve relevant challenges facing these organizations and put the skills they’ve honed at the Academy into action
- Tasked with creating ideas of how Pandora and Snapchat could implement features from one application into the other to bolster both apps’ popularity
- Performed market research on both apps’ target demographics and then created paper/digital prototypes alongside based on the findings
- Compiled the finished concepts into a pitch presented to to Snapchat Design Team and Pandora CFO for possible implementation


- The Pandora site specifically focused on designing and prototyping Pandora integrations into Snapchat (and vise versa) and how to improve the app's experience for Latinx/Spanish-Speaking users.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Monitored and helped moderate virtual (Zoom) class sessions for second and third year SMASH students
- Classes centered on game development with Python and Java respectively
- Answered student questions regarding coursework, projects, and technical issues through Piazza outside of class hours
- Observed and discussed improvements that could be made to the course with teachers and Program Manager

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Provide childcare to 1 - 6 children ages 0 - 3 years regularly during services
- Maintained records on allergies and contact information
-Learned about basic childcare and keeping an organized and safe playspace.

- Directed the livestream production of Liberty High School's 2016 Graduation Ceremony
- Then helped produce the school's video announcements
- Managed a crew of three camaramen and ran our switching hardware concurrently.

projects.title: Spooky Chess
projects.description:
UI Designer - 3D Multiplayer Chess Variant (C++/Unreal)

Created 2D assets for prototypes, documentation and the game’s UI. Designed the menus using Unreal’s widget constructor

Collaborated using Github with front and back end programmers to implement login/guest functionality as well as piece customization

projects.title: Call of the Moon
projects.description:
Project Lead - Card-Based RPG

Initially a solo project, where the mechanics and dramatic elements were all established. Then selected to be a final project, so a team was recruited to help with expansion and polishing.  Continued to lead the development of game mechanics, focusing specifically on a card “choose-your-own-adventure” system while also working as the lead writer.

Worked with my team to maintain a cohesive aesthetic across the visuals and text, while also managing the scheduling and resources for the group

organizations.name: Management Leadership for Tomorrow (Ascend)
organizations.description:
MLT aims to equip and embolden high-achieving women and men from underrepresented communities – African American, Latino/a and Native American – to realize their full potential, to make a mark and make a difference.
MLT Ascend is a college success and career readiness program in which MLT alumni volunteer to coach first-generation, low-income college students.

organizations.name: SMASH: UC Berkeley
organizations.description:
Summer Math and Science Honor Academy. A three-year summer program with the goal of prepping high-achieving minority students to success in STEM classes and careers in the future.
Students reside on campus for five weeks and attend classes seven days a week. Aside from STEM, Social Justice, Networking, and Community Building are heavily stressed as students form connections not only among themselves, but also with STEM professional on many given opprotunities.
After graduating (Sumer 2016), alumn are encouraged to work with the program and give back, whether through returning as an Residental Advisor, a Teaching Assistant, or moving on to the parant orgnization Level Playing Field Institute.
